text: The SIPROTEC 7SD87 is a differential protection device for selective protection and 1- or 3-pole tripping of overhead lines and cables. It supports various infeed configurations and protects transformers and compensating coils.
heading: Why SIPROTEC 7SD87?

text: Protect power systems from overhead line and cable faults. Our device provides selective protection and rapid tripping, quickly isolating faults to maintain system stability and minimize downtime. An adaptive algorithm maintains sensitivity and stability, even with varying transformer errors or current-transformer saturation. Isolate faults quickly with a 9 ms minimum tripping time. Adapt the modular SIPROTEC 5 system to your specific needs through flexible I/O structures.
